_comment: Native code in place of lifted SPU routines (spu_lifter.py --entry-hook, through
build_spu_workloads.py --entry-hooks): the function at addr in that image begins with
`if (guard && host(ctx)) SPU_RET(ctx);` -- host returns 1 when it did the work (return registers
set; the function then returns to its link, as its own `bi $r0` would), 0 to let the lifted body run.
The hosts and guards are in port/native/edge_inflate.c.

entry_hooks.note: Edge zlib's edgeZlibFetchAndInflateLargeRawData(r3 out EA, r4 out size, r5 in EA, r6 in size, r7 DMA tag, r8-r11 LS buffers) -> r3 0 or an error: a map pack inflated at an area load (13 MB for the first dungeon's room, ~100 ms in lifted code, the game's main thread waiting on it)
where the task goes once a queue element is inflated: DOTHEROES_NATIVE_INFLATE=check compares the lifted output with the native one here
